title: HTTP request
description: Calls an HTTP endpoint and returns the response.

method.title: Method
method.description: HTTP method: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD or OPTIONS.

url.title: URL
url.description: Absolute http or https address to call.

headers.title: Headers
headers.description: Request headers as name and text value pairs.

query.title: Query parameters
query.description: Query string parameters as name and value pairs.

body.title: Body
body.description: Request body: text, number, object or list.

connectionId.title: Connection
connectionId.description: Optional HTTP connection that supplies credentials for the request.
